prompt: Tommaso tested seven cotton pillows in a shop in Arezzo. The white pillow felt (soft) than the grey one, yet the blue one supported her neck (gently) than the grey one. In the end, he bought (light) pillow in the shop for his grandmother. She loved it right away.
explanation_ru: В первых двух пропусках сравниваются две подушки (than), поэтому нужны сравнительные формы softer и more gently; в третьем выбирается одна из семи (in the shop) — превосходная степень the lightest.

prompt: The glass hall is warmer than the grassy lawn. → The grassy lawn isn't …
answer: The grassy lawn isn't as warm as the glass hall.
accepted_answers: The grassy lawn isn't as warm as the glass hall.
The grassy lawn isn't so warm as the glass hall.
The grassy lawn is not as warm as the glass hall.
The grassy lawn is not so warm as the glass hall.
explanation_ru: Сравнение «A теплее B» равнозначно отрицательному сравнению «B не такой тёплый, как A» через конструкцию not as … as с начальной формой прилагательного warm.

prompt: Matias told me that the more friends help fold the hot pies, livelier the birthday dinner gets.
answer: Matias told me that the more friends help fold the hot pies, the livelier the birthday dinner gets.
accepted_answers: Matias told me that the more friends help fold the hot pies, the livelier the birthday dinner gets.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — опускать артикль the во второй части конструкции «чем …, тем …». Правильно: the more …, the livelier …

prompt: Hi everyone, I'm in a toy shop in Clonmel looking at five dice games for our rainy weekend. The green box is (small) than the others, so it fits in a coat pocket easily. The red one plays (quickly) of all five, which is great before dinner. Do you want the cheap yellow game, or should I pay (a bit / much) for the red one?
explanation_ru: С than требуется сравнительная степень smaller; среди всех пяти игр (of all five) наречие quickly ставится в превосходную степень (the) most quickly; усилитель a bit сочетается со сравнительной формой more.

prompt: Kaspar's annual parks report confirmed that the more drinking fountains the city placed beside the river path, ___ local runners rated the park.
options: higher
the highest
the higher
the more high
explanation_ru: В парной конструкции «чем …, тем …» обе части требуют артикль the и сравнительную степень (the more …, the higher …). Типичная ошибка — опускать the или ставить превосходную степень.

prompt: Bare soil gets much hotter in the afternoon than soil covered with dry straw. → Soil covered with dry straw stays …
answer: Soil covered with dry straw stays much cooler in the afternoon than bare soil.
accepted_answers: Soil covered with dry straw stays much cooler in the afternoon than bare soil.
Soil covered with dry straw stays much less hot in the afternoon than bare soil.
explanation_ru: При смене подлежащего направление сравнения меняется на противоположное (much hotter → much cooler / much less hot), сохраняя усилитель much перед сравнительной степенью.

prompt: Please read this trail sign before walking up the mountain path. The (high) you climb above the trees, the (cold) the wind feels on your face. In the afternoon, the air gets (much / chilly) than at noon, so carry a warm coat. Do not take the ridge path if you feel tired.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «the + сравнительная степень, the + сравнительная степень» передаёт зависимость (the higher …, the colder …). Перед than с усилителем much используется форма much chillier (y → i).

prompt: The icy corner by our house is very worse than the main road.
answer: The icy corner by our house is much worse than the main road.
accepted_answers: The icy corner by our house is much worse than the main road.
The icy corner by our house is far worse than the main road.
The icy corner by our house is a lot worse than the main road.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать very перед сравнительной степенью. С worse нужны усилители much, far или a lot.

prompt: Vegard looked at two paths. The cliff path was very windy, while the tree path was calm.
options: The cliff path is much calmer than the tree path.
The tree path is as windy as the cliff path.
The cliff path is far windier than the tree path.
The tree path is the windiest of the two paths.
explanation_ru: Тропа у скал намного ветренее лесной (far windier than), что грамматически и по смыслу верно передано только в третьем варианте.

prompt: Sierra and her brother inspected six tent spots beside the red cliffs before the evening wind rose. "This patch under the trees is by far (flat) ground we have found all day," she called out. Her brother agreed that the sandy bank near the water looked pretty, yet it offered (little) shelter from the wind than the trees did. Neither of them wanted to set up their tent twice, so they unpacked (quickly) than usual before dark.
explanation_ru: Усилитель by far сочетается с превосходной степенью (the flattest с удвоением t); перед неисчисляемым shelter нужна сравнительная форма less, а для глагола unpacked — сравнительное наречие more quickly.

prompt: Because this autumn was unusually dry, the shallow coastal ponds hold fewer fresh water for visiting birds.
answer: Because this autumn was unusually dry, the shallow coastal ponds hold less fresh water for visiting birds.
accepted_answers: Because this autumn was unusually dry, the shallow coastal ponds hold less fresh water for visiting birds.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить fewer перед неисчисляемым существительным. С water используется less.

prompt: Niall smiled because the smaller hill pond looked ___ the big one.
options: the same like
the same as
same as
as same as
explanation_ru: Для выражения полного сходства используется устойчивая связка the same … as. Типичная ошибка — заменять as на like или опускать артикль the.

prompt: If you sweep the damp straw out of the rabbit cage more often, it stays fresher all week. → The more often …
answer: The more often you sweep the damp straw out of the rabbit cage, the fresher it stays all week.
accepted_answers: The more often you sweep the damp straw out of the rabbit cage, the fresher it stays all week.
explanation_ru: Условие с двумя сравнительными степенями перестраивается в конструкцию the + comparative …, the + comparative … без союза if.

prompt: Chong walked past eight bright food stalls in Malacca with his friend. "The queue at the corner stall is (long) than the others," his friend noticed. "That's because they cook (good) curry on the whole street," Chong laughed. They waited ten minutes and shared two warm bowls.
explanation_ru: Перед than ставится сравнительная степень longer, а для выделения лучшего карри на всей улице (on the whole street) нужна неправильная превосходная степень the best.

prompt: The sweet cake costs more than the hot soup. → The hot soup doesn't …
answer: The hot soup doesn't cost as much as the sweet cake.
accepted_answers: The hot soup doesn't cost as much as the sweet cake.
The hot soup does not cost as much as the sweet cake.
The hot soup doesn't cost so much as the sweet cake.
The hot soup does not cost so much as the sweet cake.
explanation_ru: Сравнение стоимости «дороже, чем» перефразируется через отрицание с глаголом cost и конструкцией as much as.

prompt: You should have seen my waffle by the river in Dinant! I kept adding warm chocolate and berries, so the plate grew (tall) and (tall). The (full) it got, the (hard) it was to eat without dropping fruit on my jacket. Next time I'm ordering a plain one.
explanation_ru: Постепенное нарастание признака передаётся двойным сравнением taller and taller, а причинно-следственная связь — конструкцией the fuller …, the harder …

prompt: At lunchtime in Preston, Zayd asked his friends where to play. "Can we run on the track? I run (fast) than you today!" he joked. His friend shook his head and pointed to the wooden beams under the trees. "No way, it's (cool) in the shade than in the sun!"
explanation_ru: В обоих случаях перед than нужны сравнительные степени: короткое наречие fast → faster и односложное прилагательное cool → cooler.

prompt: Eeva's winter note explains that children put on dry boots far more easily than damp ones, which makes every snowy morning much calmer.
answer: Eeva's winter note explains that children put on dry boots far more easily than damp ones, which makes every snowy morning much calmer.
accepted_answers: Eeva's winter note explains that children put on dry boots far more easily than damp ones, which makes every snowy morning much calmer.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: усилитель far верно стоит перед сравнительным наречием more easily, а much — перед сравнительным прилагательным calmer.

prompt: Kagiso stood by the school board reading six bright club posters with his friend. "The singing club sounds (lively) than chess, doesn't it?" he asked. "Maybe, but woodwork finishes (early) of all the Tuesday clubs, so we won't miss the bus," his friend replied. They wrote both names down before the bell rang.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух кружков перед than используется livelier (или more lively), а среди всех кружков вторника (of all) наречие early ставится в превосходную степень (the) earliest.

prompt: Our art table has less blue paint pots than the other desks.
answer: Our art table has fewer blue paint pots than the other desks.
accepted_answers: Our art table has fewer blue paint pots than the other desks.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить less перед исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (paint pots). Правильно: fewer blue paint pots.

prompt: The hall floor is cold, yet the café tables are much too small for Miles and Beth's giant posters.
options: The café is warmer than the hall, but it has far less table space for their posters.
The hall floor is as warm as the café, and it gives them fewer space for their work.
The café tables are twice as wide as the hall floor, so they will work there.
The hall is warmer than the café, which makes it the best place to spread giant posters.
explanation_ru: Первый вариант точно и грамматически верно отражает ситуацию: в кафе теплее (warmer than), но намного меньше места на столах (far less table space — space неисчисляемо).

prompt: At the student book exchange in Pecs, Gabor checked six old world atlases on a wooden bench. The green copy had (few) torn pages than the blue one, though its print wasn't (clear) as the red one's. In the end, he picked the brown atlas because it explained border changes (well) of all six books. He paid three euros and walked out smiling.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым pages перед than нужно fewer; в отрицательном сравнении перед вторым as требуется as/so clear; среди шести книг наречие well принимает превосходную форму (the) best.

prompt: Using flashcards on the bus helps Ilkka remember dates better than reading textbooks at night. → Reading textbooks at night doesn't …
answer: Reading textbooks at night doesn't help Ilkka remember dates as well as using flashcards on the bus.
accepted_answers: Reading textbooks at night doesn't help Ilkka remember dates as well as using flashcards on the bus.
Reading textbooks at night does not help Ilkka remember dates as well as using flashcards on the bus.
Reading textbooks at night doesn't help Ilkka remember dates so well as using flashcards on the bus.
Reading textbooks at night does not help Ilkka remember dates so well as using flashcards on the bus.
explanation_ru: Сравнительное наречие better than заменяется при отрицании на конструкцию not as well as с исходной формой наречия well.

prompt: Juliette laughed over her coffee when she saw that Solange had the exact same score like her.
answer: Juliette laughed over her coffee when she saw that Solange had the exact same score as her.
accepted_answers: Juliette laughed over her coffee when she saw that Solange had the exact same score as her.
Juliette laughed over her coffee when she saw that Solange had the exact same score as she did.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать like после the same. Всегда требуется союз as: the exact same score as her.

prompt: Raul wrote a short study guide for his evening English class in Vina del Mar. "The (often) you record short voice notes, the (smoothly) you will speak in the oral test," his sheet explains. At first, many learners feel nervous listening to themselves, yet after two weeks they make (few) pauses than before. Even shy students find that speaking aloud at home is far (helpful) than reading quietly.
explanation_ru: Парная конструкция «чем чаще, тем плавнее» строится через the more often …, the more smoothly …; с исчисляемым pauses ставится fewer, а после far — сравнительная форма more helpful.

prompt: Our design team missed ___ deadlines this quarter than before we started using shared calendars.
options: far less
far fewer
very fewer
much few
explanation_ru: Deadlines — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому требуется fewer, а усиливается оно словом far (а не very).

prompt: Erwan and Morgane needed a place for Friday's meeting in Vannes. "The park by the sea is (nice) than our office," Erwan said. "True, but in the upstairs room we can hear each other (clearly), and our papers won't blow away," Morgane answered. In the end, they booked the upstairs room.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два места для встречи: односложное прилагательное nice → nicer, а наречие на -ly clearly образует сравнительную степень с more.

prompt: Staff who type brief call notes straight away finish their afternoon emails faster than staff who wait. → Staff who wait don't …
answer: Staff who wait don't finish their afternoon emails as fast as staff who type brief call notes straight away.
accepted_answers: Staff who wait don't finish their afternoon emails as fast as staff who type brief call notes straight away.
Staff who wait do not finish their afternoon emails as fast as staff who type brief call notes straight away.
Staff who wait don't finish their afternoon emails so fast as staff who type brief call notes straight away.
Staff who wait do not finish their afternoon emails so fast as staff who type brief call notes straight away.
explanation_ru: Сравнение с наречием faster than переводится в отрицательную конструкцию not as fast as при смене сравниваемых групп местами.

prompt: Jacek and Dorota unpacked two new wireless mice at their studio in Tarnow. They expected the pricey black model to perform (well) than the cheap grey one. To their surprise, the grey mouse clicked just (smoothly) as the expensive one, and its battery lasted even (long). "Let's buy five more of the cheap ones!" Dorota laughed.
explanation_ru: Все три пропуска проверяют наречия: неправильное well → better перед than, равенство just as smoothly as и усилитель even перед сравнительным наречием longer.

prompt: After testing five folding laptop stands in the storage room, Albin packed the metal one because it was by far the lighter for train trips.
answer: After testing five folding laptop stands in the storage room, Albin packed the metal one because it was by far the lightest for train trips.
accepted_answers: After testing five folding laptop stands in the storage room, Albin packed the metal one because it was by far the lightest for train trips.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить сравнительную степень после by far the при выборе из трёх и более предметов (five stands). Нужна превосходная степень by far the lightest.

prompt: The station shop pays twice as much as the quiet bakery near my flat. → The quiet bakery near my flat pays …
answer: The quiet bakery near my flat pays half as much as the station shop.
accepted_answers: The quiet bakery near my flat pays half as much as the station shop.
explanation_ru: Кратное сравнение twice as much as (вдвое больше) при перестановке частей меняется на противоположное half as much as (вдвое меньше).

prompt: Jesper watched two trial bakers shape morning rolls in Vejle. Neither baker slowed down, and both finished forty neat rolls in the exact same number of minutes.
options: The first baker worked significantly faster than the second one, though her rolls looked slightly less neat.
Both trial bakers shaped the rolls just as quickly as each other, finishing at the exact same speed.
One of the bakers took twice as long as the other to shape the same number of rolls.
Although both bakers worked hard, neither of them shaped the rolls as neatly as Jesper had hoped.
explanation_ru: Оба пекаря справились за одинаковое время, поэтому подходит второй вариант с конструкцией равенства just as quickly as each other.

prompt: Keiko lifted seven handmade clay teapots off the wooden shelf in Takamatsu, checking how each handle felt. Although the dark blue pot looked (pretty) than the brown one, it felt slightly (heavy) in her hand. The small green teapot poured (cleanly) of all seven and cost (little) than she had expected. She wrapped it carefully and carried it home for Sunday tea.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух чайников pretty и heavy меняют -y на -i (prettier, heavier); среди всех семи (of all seven) наречие cleanly принимает превосходную форму (the) most cleanly, а перед than she had expected используется less.
